finding.defect: registerProperty() checked that preset labels and values were strings, but did not validate preset values against the same typed rules applied when an Inspector submits the value. Duplicate/blank labels could also render ambiguous controls.
finding.impact: A registered Inspector could advertise a preset that its own command rejects, or present indistinguishable preset buttons.
finding.fix: The shared normalizeInspectorValue() now validates and canonicalizes each registered preset. Labels are trimmed, non-empty, and unique. Validation happens before registry insertion, so any invalid preset rejects the registration atomically.
finding.reuse_review: Reused the project-owned property registry and Inspector normalizer, added no external code, parallel schema, dependency, or infrastructure. Registered defaults continue to use the same validator.
